import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-fold-gemm')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
obj = root/'k.elf'
assert sha(obj)=='209f4165a46672d5289816f0df6b41cf5a3f44d78452ff2a28c8cd7a0e1b77d1'
selection=json.loads((root/'selected.json').read_text())
records=[]
for c in selection['records']:
    rows=c['rows']
    if rows==8192: continue
    (root/'symbol.txt').write_text(c['name'])
    (root/'args.bin').write_bytes(bytes.fromhex(c['args_hex'])+bytes(4))
    expected=root/'expected'/f'y-{rows}.bin'
    cmd=[str(root/'hsa'),str(obj),str(root/'symbol.txt'),str(root/'args.bin'),str(c['grid'][0]),str(root/'expected'/f'x-{rows}.bin'),str(root/'expected'/'weight.bin'),str(expected)]
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
    assert p.returncode==0,(rows,p.returncode,p.stderr)
    d=json.loads(p.stdout); d.update(rows=rows,expected_sha256=sha(expected)); records.append(d)
    print(json.dumps(d),flush=True)
(root/'hsa.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(records=records,object_sha256=sha(obj),driver_sha256=sha(root/'hsa'),source_sha256=sha(root/'hsa.c'),scope='Plow C HSA matrix kernel only; six captured-normalized geometries, exact full FP32 outputs against hipBLASLt, three poisoned reuses and 512B guards; not full native fold pipeline or Rust adapter qualification'),indent=2)+'\n')
reproduction_sources.export.py:
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import torch

root = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-fold-gemm')
capture = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-prefill-current')
out = root/'expected'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
torch.set_num_threads(8)
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest')
def read(name, dtype):
    return torch.frombuffer(bytearray((capture/f'{name}.prefill.bin').read_bytes()), dtype=dtype).clone()
w = read('weight', torch.bfloat16).reshape(8,512,256).cuda().float()
(out/'weight.bin').write_bytes(w.cpu().numpy().tobytes())
p = read('opart', torch.float32).reshape(8192,8,1,512).cuda()
m = read('mlpart', torch.float32).reshape(8192,8,1,2).cuda()
fn = ctypes.CDLL(str(root/'helpers.so')).plow_normalize
fn.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]*3+[ctypes.c_uint]*3+[ctypes.c_void_p]
fn.restype = ctypes.c_int
for rows in [128,512,2048,4463,4464,8191]:
    x = torch.empty(8,rows,512,device='cuda',dtype=torch.float32)
    assert fn(x.data_ptr(),p.data_ptr(),m.data_ptr(),rows,8,1,torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)==0
    y = torch.bmm(x,w)
    assert bool(y.isfinite().all())
    (out/f'x-{rows}.bin').write_bytes(x.cpu().numpy().tobytes())
    (out/f'y-{rows}.bin').write_bytes(y.cpu().numpy().tobytes())
    print(rows, flush=True)
